name: progress
title: Progress
description: Two shapes — linear (default; 4 px tall stroke with optional label / value cluster) and circular (a ring; ideal for upload completion or small inline indicators). Renders determinate when value is provided, indeterminate when value is undefined. The brand stroke uses color.accent.500 — primary action and progress share the same hue because both represent forward motion. Distinct from Spinner (no value, ≤ 5 s).
